summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting that it and parent WISeKey established Quantisimo Corp., a SPAC-type vehicle, which signed a non-binding LOI with GigCapital8 Corp. (Nasdaq: GIW) for a business combination. The proposed transaction implies a pre-money enterprise value of ~$575M, with plans to increase to $2B via up to five additional quantum acquisitions. The deal is expected to close in Q1 2027. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16; it equates to a US SPAC merger announcement. Watch for definitive agreement, regulatory clearance, and shareholder votes; risk-arb centers on LOI non-binding nature and execution of build-up strategy.
